acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves local detection and fail-closed behavior for declared authority candidates; it does not make untracked files canonical.
evidenceRequired: A QuoteFlow-style regression fixture detects the canonical index plus all eight linked product-intelligence artifacts.
The exact read-only QuoteFlow pilot reports REVIEW_REQUIRED and design LOCKED while those authorities remain untracked.

completionCriteria: The authority scanner detects the product-intelligence index, baselines, capability map, outcome contract, guardrails, experiment ledger, metrics, journey model, and event schema when untracked.
Every detected candidate records its inferred or declared authority roles without silently promoting it to canonical authority.
Any untracked critical authority locks material design and produces a reviewable finding.
Regression evidence distinguishes tracked authority, untracked candidate, and unrelated documentation.
nonObjectives: Do not automatically track, adopt, or ratify discovered files.
Do not infer authority from the word canonical outside an explicit declaration or repository-native index.
Do not claim exhaustive authority discovery when graph or repository coverage is incomplete.
objective: Fail closed when new product-intelligence authorities appear outside the governed repository snapshot.
title: Detect every untracked product-intelligence authority
